mainBaseline.method: Inject main TrailPlateBirth source read-only from git show into current AntController; all other simulation modules are current branch.

provenance.method: Fresh controllers; matched LCG seeds; both use the born-surface bridge with a resolved mock AudioEngine. OFF has baseSubstrate false; ON has it true and enables audio. Every tick hashes RNG, complete agent snapshots (including gait/bodyPose), pheromone, SurfaceField, ordered FOOT_CONTACT payloads, birth descriptors, and stratigraphy state. Audio command posts are captured from the two mock worklet transports.
provenance.limits: This proves deterministic command-level and simulation-state invariance under a mock transport. It does not measure PCM; use the browser OfflineAudioContext capture for acoustic output evidence.
